module_summary: Source-side storage of a gray-code CDC FIFO: a register array written at src_widx_i when src_write_i is high, exposed asynchronously to the destination domain.

anchors.name: data_q
anchors.why: FIFO entry register array, written per index, drives async_data_o to destination domain

anchors.name: src_data_i
anchors.why: Write data payload stored into selected FIFO entry

anchors.name: src_write_i
anchors.why: Write enable loading data_q from data_d

anchors.name: src_widx_i
anchors.why: Write index port selecting which FIFO entry gets src_data_i

anchors.name: data_d
anchors.why: Next value of storage array with one entry replaced

groups.name: fifo_storage
groups.description: FIFO data array register and its next-state update, read asynchronously by destination

groups.name: write_port
groups.description: Source write interface: data, index and write enable
